name: BYTE PHANTOM
realCapabilities: Cross-platform private IPv4 Network Radar and persistent local journal
Read-only gateway, DNS resolver, transport, interface, local IPv4, and default-route intelligence on Windows and Android
User-initiated DNS resolution and two HTTPS connectivity checks on Windows and Android

android.diagnostics: InetAddress system DNS lookup and HttpURLConnection HTTPS checks

security: Connectivity diagnostics make one DNS lookup and two fixed HTTPS GET requests only when the user explicitly starts the check. They do not scan LAN hosts or ports, test credentials, exploit devices, or modify network configuration.
